svg.aria-label: Sora: open VPN client for Windows and Linux. The Flutter app talks gRPC to sora-core, a Go service that runs sing-box, Xray or mihomo behind a TUN adapter or system proxy and keeps the kill switch on nftables or WFP.
svg.title: Sora: open VPN client for Windows and Linux. The Flutter app talks gRPC to sora-core, a Go service that runs sing-box, Xray or mihomo behind a TUN adapter or system proxy and keeps the kill switch on nftables or WFP.
